_about: Machine-readable stage list derived from pipeline_design.md. Edit this when the design changes, then run: python experiments/experiment_5/tools/scaffold_stages.py. Nodes = stage x task. 'purpose' may be a string or {task: string}. '{task}' in depends_on is replaced by the node's task.

stages.title: Contract
stages.purpose: Freeze tasks, targets, positive class, eligible populations, excluded post-outcome columns, stakeholders, metrics, the illustrative FN:FP = 5:1 cost, decision/tie rules, model families and search budget - before any result.
outputs: task_contract.md (per-task prediction time, stakeholder action, limits)
gate: Every number later stages need is in protocol.yaml
Decision rules and tie-breaks written before any result
Teacher/TA/brief rows for S00 in spec/sources.md satisfied
Milestone 2 TA comments added to spec/sources.md section 3.2
stages.gate_question: Are targets, populations, metrics, decision rules and budget frozen before any result?

stages.title: Records
stages.purpose: Build the deterministic order-level feature/target table from the Milestone 2 joins and formulas; audit keys, join cardinality, units, review aggregation, target-availability timestamps, freight_ratio and zero-item classification eligibility.
outputs: records.csv.gz (IDs for audit + features + targets + timestamps)
gate: Only row-local deterministic formulas; nothing learned
Leakage exclusions listed and checked
Label sensitivity (minimum vs first review) recorded
Raw data hashes recorded
stages.gate_question: Are joins, grains, units, eligibility and leakage exclusions verified?

stages.title: Partitions
stages.purpose: Freeze selection folds (four earlier expanding windows), the confirmation window (last pre-terminal window) and the Milestone 2 terminal benchmark manifest; customer purge and label maturity at every fit origin.
gate: No Milestone 2 held-out IDs in development
Training outcomes available before each fit origin
Customers purged across train/validation
Both classes present in every fold (classification)
stages.gate_question: Are windows chronological, customers purged, labels mature and both classes supported?

stages.title: EDA
stages.purpose: Question-driven EDA on SELECTION data only: missingness, distributions/tails, seasonality, geography/basket relations, feature-target associations, linear design rank. Produce a small declared set of candidate changes.
outputs: candidate_rationale.csv (change, observation, literature, hypothesis, stage to test)
gate: Only the selection population loaded
Each proposed change linked to an observation
Nothing fitted on all development and fed into CV
stages.gate_question: Does every planned change follow from an observed, selection-only finding?

stages.title: Baselines

purpose.regression: Matched simplest baselines on the 9-feature core via e5lib.factory: median DummyRegressor, plain LinearRegression, documented single DecisionTreeRegressor.
purpose.classification: Matched simplest baselines on the 9-feature core via e5lib.factory: prior DummyClassifier, unregularised LogisticRegression (penalty=None), documented single DecisionTreeClassifier.

gate: Identical rows and folds for all candidates
Preprocessing inside folds
Solver/convergence recorded
Simplest baseline per family exists
stages.gate_question: Do simplest matched baselines exist on identical rows and folds?

stages.title: Features

purpose.regression: Diagnose baselines (residual vs fitted, residual distribution, Q-Q, state/distance/basket errors) and compare core 9 vs 11 features with estimator and preprocessing held fixed; permutation importance on validation rows of a named model.
purpose.classification: Diagnose baselines (AP/PR, ROC, Brier, prevalence, reliability) and compare core 9 vs 12 features with estimator and preprocessing held fixed; permutation importance on validation rows of a named model.

gate: Only features change between paired candidates
Importance attributed to the right model
stages.gate_question: Do expansions help with estimator and preprocessing fixed?

stages.title: Interventions

purpose.regression: One-change-at-a-time ablations: raw vs log1p vs log1p+cap60 target (always evaluated on uncapped lead_days), input logs separately, LinearRegression vs Ridge, single tree vs pruned tree vs starter forest.
purpose.classification: One-change-at-a-time ablations: input logs, unregularised vs finite-C logistic, single tree vs pruned tree vs starter forest.

gate: Each added complexity justified by the protocol rule
Simpler variant kept when the rule fails
stages.gate_question: Is each added complexity justified one change at a time?

stages.title: Tuning
stages.purpose: Bounded grid search over COMPLETE pipelines on selection folds using protocol.yaml grids; compare the winner with dummy and simplest family on identical rows.
outputs: grid_results.csv (every config: params, fold scores, mean, SD, rank, runtime, convergence)
gate: No post-search configuration switch
Pooled OOF vs mean-fold kept distinct
Winner compared with baselines
stages.gate_question: Is the winner a complete pipeline, compared with dummy and simplest family?

stages.title: Policy

purpose.regression: Learning curves, interpretation (simple-tree rules, permutation importance of the selected model) and error profile; freeze the regression recipe before confirmation.
purpose.classification: Learning curves, interpretation, calibration choice (raw vs in-training sigmoid), then threshold choice from selection OOF (no alerts, 0.50, 0.17, empirical optimum); freeze the recipe before confirmation.

outputs: threshold_table.csv (classification: counts, precision, recall, F1, alerts, cost)
gate: Probability recipe frozen before threshold (classification)
Recipe frozen before S09
No confirmation/benchmark labels used
stages.gate_question: Is the recipe (and probability/threshold policy) frozen before confirmation?

stages.title: Confirmation
stages.purpose: Fit frozen recipes at confirmation start; evaluate the reserved confirmation window for the selected pipeline AND dummy / plain-linear / simple-tree references on identical rows.
gate: Recipe unchanged from S08
Matched references included
Reopen documented in CHANGELOG if triggered
stages.gate_question: Does the frozen method hold up without being changed?

stages.title: Benchmark
stages.purpose: Refit the unchanged recipe on all eligible pre-terminal training; score the Milestone 2 terminal benchmark once; subgroup and error analysis; persist complete bundles.
outputs: bundle/ (pipeline, calibrator, threshold, schema, versions, training-ID digest, checksums)
gate: Benchmark scored once per release
Benchmark described as historical, not unseen
Bundle is the exact evaluated artifact
stages.gate_question: Is the confirmed recipe refitted unchanged and scored once?

stages.title: Deployment
stages.purpose: Reload bundles, verify in-memory vs reloaded parity, validate single/batch/missing/invalid/unknown inputs; Streamlit app with two task tabs using held-out records as simulated orders.
outputs: app/ (Streamlit app code; runs from this node folder, loads S10 bundles from their outputs/)
gate: App loads the S10 bundle unchanged
Inference never fits
App and bundles stay inside experiments/experiment_5/ (no deployment/ changes before migration)
stages.gate_question: Does the app load the same artifact and reproduce its predictions?

stages.title: Package
stages.purpose: Build evidence/build from evidence/registry.yaml; master metric table; verify every report/deck/app number against numbers.json; cut the release tag.
outputs: deliverables/ report & deck drafts that cite evidence IDs
gate: run_pipeline.py check passes
Every report/deck number traces to an evidence ID
Story follows design section E
Nothing written outside experiments/experiment_5/; migration only on the experiment lead's instruction (README section 12)
stages.gate_question: Does every number in report, deck and app trace to one release?
